arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test R1: trailing newline
print('=== R1 Tests ===')
# Test matching string ending with newline
r = parse.parse('hello\n', 'hello\n')
print(f'parse(\"hello\\n\", \"hello\\n\") = {r}')

r = parse.parse('{}\n', 'world\n')
print(f'parse(\"{{}}\\n\", \"world\\n\") = {r}')

r = parse.parse('{:d}\n', '42\n')
print(f'parse(\"{{:d}}\\n\", \"42\\n\") = {r}')

# Test R2: digit field numbering
print('\\n=== R2 Tests ===')
# Try digit-based field numbering with format specs
try:
    r = parse.parse('{0:d}', '42')
    print(f'parse(\"{{0:d}}\", \"42\") = {r}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'parse(\"{{0:d}}\", \"42\") raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

try:
    r = parse.parse('{0:d}{1:s}', '42 hello')
    print(f'parse(\"{{0:d}}{{1:s}}\", \"42 hello\") = {r}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'parse(\"{{0:d}}{{1:s}}\", \"42 hello\") raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

try:
    r = parse.parse('{0:d}', 'abc')  # Should fail because abc is not an int
    print(f'parse(\"{{0:d}}\", \"abc\") = {r}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'parse(\"{{0:d}}\", \"abc\") raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
"
